title: CGNS mesh and data model
overview: CGNS is a CFD data standard and library ecosystem. Its SIDS model organizes bases, zones, grid coordinates, element sections, boundary conditions, zone connectivity, units and optional solution fields. A valid CGNS file is not a renamed or text-wrapped mesh file.
principle: CGNS carries more than coordinates and connectivity. Zone type/dimensions, element sections, BC nodes, connectivity and dimensional units contribute semantics. CGNSBase_t groups zones; Zone_t declares structured/unstructured topology; GridCoordinates_t stores coordinates; Elements_t stores element sections; BC_t and ZoneGridConnectivity_t carry boundary/interface meaning.
architecture: OneFLOW Mesh Core -> CGNS adapter -> CGNS Mid-Level Library / HDF5 or ADF backend. Reader maps Base/Zone/Elements/BC/ZoneGridConnectivity and units into neutral entities plus retained metadata; unsupported semantics are reported as losses.

proves: Architecture identifies the future CGNS adapter boundary and major CGNS mesh nodes to preserve.
does_not_prove: Current placeholder .cgns output is a CGNS file.
A production CGNS reader/writer is implemented or linked.
All zone, BC, connectivity, units and high-order semantics are preserved.
